defmodule UploadConsumer do
  @moduledoc """
  Message queue consumer that processes user-uploaded files
  by forwarding them to an internal microservice via HTTP.
  """

  use GenServer
  require Logger

  @internal_service_host "internal-processor.local"
  @internal_service_port 8080
  @max_body_size 10_485_760

  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end

  def init(opts) do
    queue_name = Keyword.get(opts, :queue, "uploads")
    {:ok, %{queue: queue_name, processing: false}}
  end

  def handle_info({:message, payload}, state) do
    case decode_upload_message(payload) do
      {:ok, upload} ->
        result = forward_to_processor(upload)
        Logger.info("Upload processed: #{inspect(result)}")
        {:noreply, %{state | processing: false}}

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Failed to decode message: #{reason}")
        {:noreply, state}
    end
  end

  defp decode_upload_message(payload) do
    case Jason.decode(payload) do
      {:ok, %{"filename" => filename, "content_type" => ct, "body" => body}} ->
        decoded_body = Base.decode64!(body)
        if byte_size(decoded_body) > @max_body_size do
          {:error, "body too large"}
        else
          {:ok, %{filename: filename, content_type: ct, body: decoded_body}}
        end

      _ ->
        {:error, "invalid payload structure"}
    end
  end

  defp forward_to_processor(%{filename: filename, content_type: content_type, body: body}) do
    sanitized_filename = sanitize_filename(filename)
    sanitized_ct = sanitize_content_type(content_type)
    request = build_http_request(sanitized_filename, sanitized_ct, body)
    send_raw_request(request)
  end

  defp sanitize_filename(filename) do
    filename
    |> String.replace(~r/[^a-zA-Z0-9._-]/, "_")
    |> String.slice(0, 255)
  end

  defp sanitize_content_type(ct) do
    ct
    |> String.replace(~r/[\r\n]/, "")
    |> String.slice(0, 128)
  end

  defp build_http_request(filename, content_type, body) do
    body_length = compute_content_length(body, content_type)

    [
      "POST /process HTTP/1.1\r\n",
      "Host: #{@internal_service_host}\r\n",
      "Content-Type: #{content_type}\r\n",
      "X-Filename: #{filename}\r\n",
      "Content-Length: #{body_length}\r\n",
      "Connection: keep-alive\r\n",
      "\r\n",
      body
    ]
    |> IO.iodata_to_binary()
  end

  @doc """
  Computes the content length. For multipart uploads, accounts for
  the boundary framing overhead. For raw uploads, uses byte_size.
  """
  defp compute_content_length(body, content_type) do
    if String.contains?(content_type, "multipart") do
      # For multipart, the framing adds overhead that we pre-calculate
      # based on the boundary parameter extraction
      boundary = extract_boundary(content_type)
      framing_overhead = byte_size("--#{boundary}--\r\n") + byte_size("--#{boundary}\r\n")
      String.length(body) + framing_overhead
    else
      byte_size(body)
    end
  end

  defp extract_boundary(content_type) do
    case Regex.run(~r/boundary=([^;\s]+)/, content_type) do
      [_, boundary] -> boundary
      _ -> "default_boundary"
    end
  end

  defp send_raw_request(request) do
    case :gen_tcp.connect(
           String.to_charlist(@internal_service_host),
           @internal_service_port,
           [:binary, active: false, packet: :raw]
         ) do
      {:ok, socket} ->
        :gen_tcp.send(socket, request)
        response = receive_response(socket)
        :gen_tcp.close(socket)
        {:ok, response}

      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Connection failed: #{inspect(reason)}")
        {:error, :connection_failed}
    end
  end

  defp receive_response(socket) do
    case :gen_tcp.recv(socket, 0, 5000) do
      {:ok, data} -> data
      {:error, _} -> ""
    end
  end
end
